_comment: states: "ALL" (every state, DC and territory the FAA has data for; v1.6 nationwide) or a list of 2-letter codes. preload: states the service worker caches at install time even if the user never picked them (empty: the app downloads only the states the user picks in Info > States, and keeps the ones an existing install already had). filter: training = public-use + military airports/heliports + private heliports.
